blurb: Guests enjoy romantic gondola cruises on the St. Croix River with options for sunlit daytime or moonlit evening rides. Cruises can be combined with meals at the Dock Café or guests can bring their own picnic including alcoholic beverages. The gondola features comfortable cushioned seats and down comforters for cooler nights, and the gondolier can take photos during the trip.
extraNote: Launch from Stillwater, Minnesota, on the St. Croix River
